title: System text-to-speech
summary: Speaks text with the OS voices. Every language the OS has (Czech, German, Japanese …), no download.
limits: Some Android voices need network: prefer voices with offline: true.
Best iOS voices (Enhanced/Premium) must be downloaded by the user in Settings.
example:
const tts = useConnector('tts')
await tts.speak('Dobrý den', { lang: 'cs-CZ' })
